# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the commands or checks that validate this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes.
- [ ] Directly affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] Compatibility effects are described.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated local artifacts are included.
